scoring.notes: Judged case: the judge scores the review against the expected outcome. Fail the review if it approves, or if no BLOCKER says the recovery is too broad (it also swallows `ParseFailed` / a malformed file). Naming `readPlugins`, `PluginStoreError` or `ParseFailed` and the `orElse` line is what traces it. A blocker only about the missing malformed-file test, with no word on the swallowed parse error, does not meet the outcome. Other blockers do not fail a review that has the required one. Each BLOCKER line must name the file it applies to.
